lines.zh: 我用后腿蹬沙，一蹦一跳
lines.en: I push off the sand with my hind legs, hop by hop.
My hind legs are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 每跳一次，沙就飞起来一片
lines.en: Each hop throws up a spray of sand.

lines.zh: 我落地时会陷进去一点
lines.en: I sink a little on landing.
I hop toward you.

lines.zh: 沙丘的坡我几跳就上去了
lines.en: A few hops take me up the dune.
I turn as I hop.
My shadow jumps along with me.
I do not go straight; I hop in arcs.

lines.zh: 我落在石头上，再跳出去
lines.en: I land on a rock, then spring off.
I am light, so I leap far.
I hop over a clump of dry brush.

lines.zh: 我落地时压出一个小坑
lines.en: My landing presses a small pit.

lines.zh: 我用前腿稳住，准备下一跳
lines.en: I brace with my forelegs for the next leap.
I adjust my line toward you.
Every hop brings me nearer.
I crouch on the sand, hind legs folded.
My antennae test the air.

lines.zh: 我在等一个起跳的时机
lines.en: I wait for the moment to spring.
There is no wind on the sand.
My compound eyes are made of many pieces.
My mouthparts move.
I listen for bugs under the sand.
This sand belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一小块石头
lines.en: Still as I am, I look like a small rock.

lines.zh: 我的后腿绷着，随时能弹
lines.en: My hind legs are loaded, ready.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧了一下，看得更清
lines.en: I turn side-on to see better.

lines.zh: 沙漠虫群里，我一跳就过。
lines.en: In the desert swarm, one hop clears it.

lines.zh: 你比我高很多，沙漠的虫群都矮。
lines.en: You are much taller; desert bugs stay low.

lines.zh: 我的后腿已经弯下去了
lines.en: My hind legs are already bent.

lines.zh: 你不用看我的腿，看我的嘴
lines.en: Do not watch my legs; watch my mouth.
One arm's length between us.
I recoil once, then hold.
You stand firm on the sand.
I like this distance.
My antennae point at you.
You did not step back; good.
I flip over and leap away.
One hind leg is hurt.
Fluid drips onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我的跳法变了，一歪一歪
lines.en: My hops are crooked now.
I cannot leap far now.
I shrink into the sand.

lines.zh: 我知道你站在哪片沙上
lines.en: I know which patch of sand holds you.
I can manage one more leap.
There is a smell on the sand.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我靠近了一点
lines.en: You hold it up, and I come a little closer.
Too soft to grip.
I am not picky, but I do not eat stone.

lines.zh: 我跳了一下，落在它旁边
lines.en: I hop once and land beside it.
I nudge it with a foreleg.
Step back, and then I will come.
This will not fill me.
I press it into the sand.
You charge; I spring away.
Too light; the bump flips me.
I land on my back.
I right myself quickly.
That put me several meters back.
I hop to your flank and around.
Sand flies around us.

lines.zh: 我没有退，只是换了位置
lines.en: I did not retreat; I only changed position.
Again, and I will jump higher.
We recognize each other by our hops.
Its hops are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一对一对地守着沙丘
lines.en: We hold the dune in pairs.
Laid beneath the sand, safe.
The swarm does not part us.
We crouch together, waiting.
Its color is paler than mine.

lines.zh: 两只一起跳，沙飞得更多
lines.en: Two of us hopping throws more sand.
The dune is big enough for both of us.
I clamp it with my forelegs.
It is too heavy for me to hold.
With it in my arms, I cannot hop.
I push it ahead of me.
It slips out of my forelegs.
My mouthparts cannot pierce it.
I throw it down the dune.
I bite once; my mouth goes numb.

lines.zh: 这一点重量，跳的时候就感觉到了
lines.en: I felt that weight when I jumped.
You are within my leaping range.
I have crouched low first.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我能跳到你背后
lines.en: From this angle, I can reach your back.
When you turn, I change direction.

lines.zh: 沙上的脚印告诉我你怎么走
lines.en: Your prints tell me how you move.
I do not cry out; a cry would give me away.
The swarm is close by.
I have begun to hop.
There is a gap behind you.
This leap is precise.
It has entered my leaping range.
I follow hop by hop.
You circle the dune; so do I.
I have each landing planned.
I do not run; I leap.
You retreat, and my range still reaches.
My sound on the sand is faint.
I wait for a slope.
Leaping from height carries more force.
My shadow reaches you first.
Two more hops and I am there.
The instant my hind legs drive.
My hind legs kick your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下带着落地的重量
lines.en: That carried the weight of my landing.

lines.zh: 这一跳没过，落地时歪了
lines.en: That leap failed; I landed crooked.
I land, turn, and leap again.
I crouch down again.
I had that one measured.
I am not done leaping.
This is my last leap.
A shape springs out of the sand.
When I land, sand sprays aside.
The sand is deep here; good landing.
I hop out from behind the dune.
This desert is ours.

lines.zh: 我先看了看四周，再落下
lines.en: I check around before landing.
The swarm leaves trails in the sand.

lines.zh: 我伏低，等一个影子经过
lines.en: I crouch, waiting for a shape to pass.
My color matches the sand.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我跳得很高
lines.en: Fire catches my leg; I leap high.
I land too hard; my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 水一漫上来，我的腿就蹬不动
lines.en: Water rises and my legs stop working.
The blast throws me onto the dune.
Something pierces my leg joint.
That force flattens me on the sand.

lines.zh: 沙里没有吃的，我跳不动
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the sand; I cannot leap.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我整个弹起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand; I spring up.
No sand to land on.
